verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents jobs whose status can be polled and webhook endpoints you can configure to be notified when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states. Together these cover the non-blocking async pattern the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the async job-submission and status-polling endpoints, webhook payload/signature/retry details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, long parses run as async jobs with status polling and completion webhooks, so my pipeline never blocks

citations.quote: Instead of continuously polling for status updates, you can configure webhook endpoints to be notified immediately when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states.
Get your first parse job running in under a minute
